name: Alfred Henry Forrester (Alfred Crowquill)
bio: Alfred Henry Forrester (1804–1872), who wrote and drew as "Alfred Crowquill", was an English illustrator, caricaturist and humorist, a contributor to Bentley's Miscellany and Punch.
He was the brother of the illustrator Charles Robert Forrester, and published comic verse and books for children alongside his drawings.

poems.title: To My Nose
poems.author: Alfred Henry Forrester (Alfred Crowquill)
poems.collection: A New Library of Poetry and Song, ed. William Cullen Bryant (1877)
poems.text:
Knows he that never took a pinch,
Nosey, the pleasure thence which flows?
Knows he the titillating joys
Which my nose knows?

O nose, I am as proud of thee
As any mountain of its snows;
I gaze on thee, and feel that pride
A Roman knows!
